questions.question: Define the purpose of clothing and list its various functions.

  • by protecting the wearer. Clothing perform a range of social and cultural
  • functions, such as individual, occupational and sexual differentiation and social
  • status. Clothing also function as a form of adornement and an expression of
  • personal taste or style.
  • PROTECTION:Clothes provide humans a source of physical protection even
  • before clothing evolved as a means of protection against the physical dangers of
  • natural calamity, evil, spirits, Demons, and spiritual powers. The type of
  • clothing was in the form of jewellery tattooing etc..
  • Then came the clothes made from animal skins and part of trees including their
  • bark to protect the body from excessive heat, cold and bites and stings of insects
  • and animals. In today times, clothes, For example, raincoat, gloves, draper
  • thermal, suits, and sports gear for the sake of protecting our bodies.
  • Protection from cold- Wear multiple layers of clothing, thick, or heavy fabrics.
  • Fur Lining:Trap body heat and create a layer of warmth.
  • Gloves and mittens: Protect the fingers from frost bites.
  • Specialised forms of protective clothing: Diving suits, space suits, firefighters
  • attire, bullet-proof, jackets, facial masks.
  • Protective gears- helmets, gloves, diving, suits, water googles.
  • COMMUNICATION: Clothing communicates various facts of a person’s life
  • such as age, sex, lifestyle, occupation, religious beliefs. Clothing reflects our
  • value system, attitudes, interest in life. Clothing also conveys self-image
  • emotions, et cetera.
  • Age: Example college student of wears, T-shirt and jeans, they change to shirts
  • and trousers in the case of an office goer.
  • Sex: Men shirts buttoned leftover right and woman right over left.
  • Marital status: Hindu woman wear mangalsutra and Sindoor.
  • Cultural influences: The traditional dress of the Japanese,the kimono, reflects
  • the culture, customs and traditions of the Japanese people.
  • DECORATION: Even before the invention of clothes, people adorn their bodies
  • with body painting, tattooing, piercing and hairstyling. Therefore, adornment in
  • clothing, enhance one’s self image through beautification, improving sexual
  • attraction and establishing social status.
